ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Primary distribution consists of low-intensity dark pixels (>90%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (~5-10%) creating high macro-level contrast across the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white focal spots and linear streaks are mapped across a low-intensity dark-gray field; concentrations are highest in the distal right region and the medial left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel depth approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed as a continuous sequence of pixel-level peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the median notch and a convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel cluster detected on the distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with rosette scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear white pixel disruptions observed predominantly on the right lobe and center-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) and white focal patches distributed across the ventral surface; distinct light cluster on the upper right-hand margin.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of roughly parallel vertical high-intensity streaks located near the lower center of the left lobe.
